commands.place: visible-place-id or JSON null for loose workspace

rules: One continuous board across home and remote camp. Mission labels do not reset or transfer things; all existing kinds remain unique globally. next finishes only when all 26 objectives have been achieved and current goals still hold.

Ordinary ingredients persist. Broken radio retires when repaired. A directly installed component remains outside only if an unmade/unretired recipe result, exact goal or present missing component slot still uses it; otherwise it stays inside the Rover and the external token retires.

Only one of each kind globally, including installed parts; retained outside representatives are the explicit reusable exception. Partners lists currently legal new-result or empty-slot targets, not result previews.

Actual target placement supplies context; surviving source returns to its original position after combination. Rover is one typed component. A Rover has blank spaces for parts, without labels until filled. Inspect legal partners to discover useful additions. Installed parts can enable travel or communication; the object reports its actual capabilities. Optional parts appear only once installed.
Placement ejects the previous occupant loose. Use place:null to move a thing loose.
Current goals must still be true at next; achieved milestones need not remain in place.
All authored raw supplies are present from the start. Only goals and places unfold; no later item grants.
No resource stocks, timer, hidden travel, or pressure variant. The CLI does not model viewport scrolling or physical drag distances.
